notes.note: Reviewed SDK SSE delta cd50f52ce4 against opening watchdog, abort-settled response handoff, attempt-scoped reader and accepted cursor handling, plus chat shared stream/status consumers. Existing authority, authentication, ordinary JSON deadlines, server replay and UI ownership claims remain accurate; canonical SDK reference now distinguishes 30-second opening from indefinite healthy body and 75-second idle watchdog. ADR historical EventSource statements remain qualified by its current reading note. CLI exemptions describe body/turn lifetime, not SDK header establishment. Executed 58 SDK/chat-consumer tests and SDK typecheck passed; new three regressions failed before fix. No physical device or deployed client recovery qualification.
